updates.title: Lobby got a refit
body: Calendar and Wingmates moved under Launch Patrol, easier reach
How to Play and Powers now match the rest of the buttons
Feedback moved to the speaker icon up top, next to Settings

updates.title: Gold Patrol: fly any past day
body: Gold Patrol can fly any past calendar day
Missed and untracked days get Fly this Patrol
Played days keep Replay this Patrol
